reason: The receiving branches attach to cell bodies and carry incoming messages toward them, matching the first goal.
expectation: The branches will form the nerve cells' receiving parts.

alternatives.reason: The other goal also names a clear pairing: fitting channels into the fibres' membranes.

effect: The branches are attached, and the new goal is to bring blood vessels beside the receiving cells.
reaction: That connection was straightforward; the blood supply is the next clear step.
reason: The fine blood vessels supply oxygen and food to cells, matching the new goal.
expectation: The vessels will be positioned beside the receiving cells.

alternatives.reason: This is the other named project and could be done first.

effect: The receiving cells now have blood vessels beside them; the long fibres still need their channels.
reaction: The vessel picture makes the blood supply clear.
reason: The remaining goal directly calls for fitting channels into the fibres' membranes.
expectation: The channels will be fitted into the fibre membranes, allowing ions through when their gates open.

effect: The channels are fitted, and the picture explains how local electrical changes travel along the fibre. The remaining goal is to join the prepared parts.
reaction: It was helpful to see that the change travels without one ion running the whole length.
reason: The supplied cell bodies already have branches and blood vessels, so joining them to the prepared fibres matches the new goal.
expectation: The receiving cells, fibres and blood supply will come together as nervous tissue.

effect: Joining the prepared parts made nervous tissue and completed the chapter. The final picture connects the fibres' signals with the blood supply that keeps the cells alive.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the separate projects come together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile: the picture showed how an electrical change travels along a fibre without one ion travelling the whole way.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the blood vessels was clear but fairly predictable compared with the channel explanation.

surprise.text: I was surprised that neighbouring channels open in turn and pass the electrical change along locally.

arbitrary.text: None of the pairings felt arbitrary; the goals and pictures made their purposes clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the membrane take on a messaging job made me curious about how nerves connect to other body systems.
